Owner(s).note:
Owner and location:
- Open the Wisconsin Department of Natural Resources air permit revision letter from August 11, 2026 at https://apps.dnr.wi.gov/warp_ext/AM_DownloadObject.aspx?id=1286845 and read page 1. It is addressed to Madison Gas & Electric Co Blount Street Station at 717 E Main St, Madison, Dane County, and calls the company the holder of operation permit 11300443A-P41.
- The permit names the company as permit holder. It does not use the word owner, so this is a partial source for the owner value.
- The permit gives a street address, not coordinates. The address is in Madison near the existing point, so the existing point is consistent with it.

CCS attachment?.note:
Carbon capture:
- The August 11, 2026 air permit at https://apps.dnr.wi.gov/warp_ext/AM_DownloadObject.aspx?id=1286845 lists the boilers, stacks and engines at the plant. It describes no carbon capture equipment on unit 6.
- A permit that is silent is weak evidence. No document that says no carbon capture in words was found.

Conversion/replacement?.note:
Conversion:
- A Wisconsin State Journal article from January 18, 2010 at https://madison.com/wsj/business/article_28618898-0489-11df-8a48-001cc4c002e0.html is headed 'In March, Blount Street plant to make gas its primary fuel'. It reports the plant switching to gas as its primary fuel.
- The article does not name unit 6 or unit 7 by number, so this only partly supports the value.

Start year.note:
Start year:
- The EIA-860M table for September 2026 at https://www.eia.gov/electricity/data/eia860m/xls/september_generator2026.xlsx, Operating sheet, plant 3992, generator 6, shows operating year 1957, nameplate 50.0 MW, status OP. That is the year the original coal boiler began operating.
- The August 11, 2026 air permit at https://apps.dnr.wi.gov/warp_ext/AM_DownloadObject.aspx?id=1286845 says 'Stack S15, Boiler B28 - Natural Gas Fired Boiler Rated at 544 MMBtu per hour (Acid Rain Unit 8). Installed 1957' (Installed 1957) and describes it as natural gas fired.
- The 2011 in GEM is the gas conversion year. The January 2010 Wisconsin State Journal article at https://madison.com/wsj/business/article_28618898-0489-11df-8a48-001cc4c002e0.html says gas becomes the primary fuel in March of 2010, so 2010 may be the better conversion year. No document was found that says 2011 for this unit, so the value is left as it is.

units.notes: The EIA-860M table for September 2026 still lists this unit as operating at 50.0 MW, and the August 2026 air permit lists the boiler as in service. No retirement notice, mothballing or owner change was found. Backup Power has no document that states it.

qa.question: Should the start year for units 6 and 7 be the 2010 gas switch instead of 2011?
qa.finding: A January 2010 Wisconsin State Journal article says gas becomes the primary fuel at Blount Street in March 2010. EIA gives 1957 and 1961, the original coal years.
qa.recommendation: Look for an MGE or Public Service Commission document that dates the gas conversion of units 6 and 7. Leave 2011 until one is found.
qa.note: Article: https://madison.com/wsj/business/article_28618898-0489-11df-8a48-001cc4c002e0.html. EIA file: https://www.eia.gov/electricity/data/eia860m/xls/september_generator2026.xlsx, Operating sheet, plant 3992. The permit at https://apps.dnr.wi.gov/warp_ext/AM_DownloadObject.aspx?id=1286845 says boilers B28 and B29 were installed 1957 and 1961. No MGE press release or commission filing was opened in this pass.
